scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @artifact-mesh/api && npm run build --workspace @artifact-mesh/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @artifact-mesh/api" "npm run dev --workspace @artifact-mesh/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @artifact-mesh/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @artifact-mesh/web
